_comment: Aether Hub's two tap modes: '{T}: Add {C}' is free, '{T}, Pay {E}: Add one mana of any color'
costs an energy counter. Shivan Gorge's '{2}{R}, {T}: deals 1 damage to each opponent' is the
only red demand on the board, and the Hub is the only red source, so the Gorge fires if and
only if the energy is there to pay for it.
With energy_counters 1 the opponent takes exactly 1. Verified DISCRIMINATING: at
energy_counters 0 the Hub strips to its colourless mode, {R} is unpayable, and the opponent
stays on 20 -- the two Mariposas still make {2}, so the difference is the colour and nothing
This is what stops the Hub becoming an infinite rainbow source under the blink loop's untaps,
which would switch on the Gorge kill for free.
